'''Pedro Guzman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 15th at [[2001 Spanish National Championship]] on 28 April 2001, according to Fernando Medalón's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2172">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-ithor-national-04-28-01d2172/ ithor-national-04-28-01], DeckTech (Fernando "Garion" Medalón, 29 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-29-ithor-national-04-28-01d2172/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
